goal.objective: Advance the UE stage from nonfinal runtime replay evidence to reviewable visual evidence, then to command-echo live evidence only after the visual gate is not blocked.
goal.reason_for_order: The existing runtime replay probe already has log-level Sunray150 visibility and nonzero bounds, but the opened screenshot does not show the UAV clearly by eye. A close or follow-camera visual gate is the shortest missing UE evidence before deeper command-echo work.

current_evidence.current_runtime_process_observation: No current UnrealEditor.exe process with MoSimSceneLibrary.uproject was found in the local process check during this planning turn.

path_a_visual_review_hardening.purpose: Produce human-readable Factory scene screenshots where the Sunray150 UAV body is clearly visible by eye.
expected_outputs: at least one after-stream close or follow-camera screenshot where the Sunray150 UAV body is visible by eye
UE log tail with first MWORKS UDP frame and Sunray first applied frame
review notes stating whether UAV visibility is accepted or still unclear
minimum_acceptance: Factory/Demonstration scene is nonblank and readable.
Sunray150 or YunZong UAV body is visible by eye in at least one screenshot, not only by log.
The screenshot is from the MoSimSceneLibrary Unreal game window, not Codex or a console/helper window.
The log still reports first MWORKS UDP frame and Sunray component visibility/nonzero bounds for the same probe.
No primitive cube/cylinder/STL fallback is used as final vehicle visual evidence.
stop_conditions: No matching MoSimSceneLibrary Unreal runtime window appears after the bounded launch/wait.
UDP port 5005 is not exposed by the expected Unreal game process within the documented timeout.
The captured image is blank, wrong-window, cropped beyond review use, or still does not show the UAV clearly after one bounded retry.
UE log lacks the MWORKS UDP first frame or Sunray first-applied-frame diagnostics.
The run would require keyboard/camera operations that move the UAV truth, save the map, change assets, or use actor pose override.
claims_allowed_if_passed: UE Factory scene rendered and captured.
Imported Sunray150 runtime visual is human-visible in the UE review window.
The accepted MWORKS replay stream reached the UE runtime visual path.
claims_still_forbidden_if_passed: closed_loop beyond the accepted MWORKS run

path_b_command_echo_live_probe.purpose: Produce and validate one seven-artifact live command-echo capture bundle.
stop_conditions: More than one live attempt would be needed.
The probe cannot produce an authoritative mosim.ue_command_echo.v1 row.
The pending request and echo identity do not match.
False-ack negative report accepts build/checker/sender/fixture/operator/state-frame evidence as command ack.
Cleanup cannot prove no listener, timer, background loop, or socket remains bound.
claims_allowed_if_passed: A single bounded live command echo bundle passed the validator.
The named command request and authoritative echo matched under the declared source/authority pair.
claims_still_forbidden_if_passed: ROS2/FAST-LIO success unless the authoritative source is specifically ROS2 runtime echo and the ROS2 evidence gate also passes

terminal_email_needed: only when the next executable slice reaches completion, blocker, or review-required terminal state
